name: ServiceNow
description: Interact with the ServiceNow API for incidents, change requests, and knowledge base operations.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.documentation: Lists incidents from ServiceNow, optionally filtered by a query.

tools.name: create_incident
tools.documentation: Creates a new incident in ServiceNow.

tools.name: update_incident
tools.documentation: Updates an existing incident in ServiceNow.

tools.name: list_change_requests
tools.documentation: Lists change requests from ServiceNow, optionally filtered by a query.

tools.name: create_change_request
tools.documentation: Creates a new change request in ServiceNow.

tools.name: update_change_request
tools.documentation: Updates an existing change request in ServiceNow.

tools.name: list_knowledge_bases
tools.documentation: Lists available knowledge bases in ServiceNow.

tools.name: list_kb_articles
tools.documentation: Lists knowledge base articles from ServiceNow, optionally filtered by a query.
